links.comparator_used: Diagnostic model in isolation, with all predictions presented equivalently
links.outcome: Expected clinician burden, with second reads for predicted disagreements on urgent findings
links.effect: Average disagreement rate 6.5%; expected burden reduction 4.8%, even if 5% of disagreements on urgent findings receive a second read
links.tradeoff: Burden balance depends on reducing disagreement false positives; the authors conclude risk mitigation can be balanced with clinician burden only if they are reduced.
links.quote: The average disagreement rate is 6.5%, and the expected burden reduction is 4.8%, even if 5% of disagreements on urgent findings receive a second read.

design_hint: disagreement-guided prediction presentation and selective second review
